act.name: Payment of Gratuity Act, 1972
act.source_authority: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing employee gratuity entitlement, determination, recovery and protection.

sections.title: Payment of gratuity.
sections.text: Section 4 governs when gratuity becomes payable and how entitlement is calculated, subject to the Act.
sections.plain_language_summary: Eligible employees may receive gratuity on termination after qualifying service, with statutory exceptions and calculation rules.

sections.title: Determination of the amount of gratuity.
sections.text: Section 7 governs notice, determination and payment of gratuity and the statutory process for disputes.
sections.plain_language_summary: Explains how gratuity is claimed, calculated, paid and determined when disputed.

sections.title: Recovery of gratuity.
sections.text: Section 8 provides for statutory recovery where payable gratuity is not paid.
sections.plain_language_summary: Unpaid gratuity can be recovered through the controlling authority using the Act's process.

sections.title: Protection of gratuity.
sections.text: Section 13 protects gratuity payable under the Act from attachment in execution of specified decrees or orders.
sections.plain_language_summary: Statutory gratuity has protection from court attachment as provided by this section.
